quarterly_data.quarter: Faraday Technology press release: Faraday Powers Intelligent Sensing with New 14nm MIPI C/D (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Faraday announced the availability of its silicon-proven MIPI C/D Combo PHY IP on UMC's 14nm FinFET process, for vision AI, machine vision, smart imaging and other SoCs needing camera and sensor interfaces: it supports MIPI C-PHY v2.0 at up to 3.0 Gsps per trio and D-PHY v2.5 at up to 4.5 Gbps per lane, and the shared combo architecture reduces IP die area by more than 30%; built-in self-test for both protocols and an Alternate Low Power mode. COO Flash Lin: edge AI and automotive smart sensing are driving the need for high-performance, power-efficient video connectivity.
quarterly_data.figure: C-PHY v2.0 up to 3.0 Gsps per trio; D-PHY v2.5 up to 4.5 Gbps per lane; IP die area reduced by more than 30%
